verdict.rationale: GrowthBook ships an official MCP server that connects AI tools like Cursor, VS Code and Claude to the product. That server loads GrowthBook Agent Skills (workflows and guardrails) and makes authenticated REST API calls, so users can drive the product through natural-language prompts in an external AI client. There is no evidence of a native in-product natural-language command interface; the Cmd+K palette is navigation only. missing for 10: native in-app natural-language command interface, documented examples of which operations can be performed by natural-language command, hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect AI tools like Cursor, VS Code, and Claude to GrowthBook using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
The official GrowthBook MCP server is a thin bridge: it loads GrowthBook Agent Skills (workflows and guardrails) and makes authenticated calls to the GrowthBook REST API.
